tools/check_continue_ui.py.why: two causes. (1) DEFECT: may_step -> resource_control.background_reason (resource_control.py:315) calls brain_runtime.host() with the hardware profile -> inference_hardware.snapshot -> dpkg-query; under the check's process hold the AssertionError is swallowed by may_step's except (agent_loop.py:781) and the service never steps. The same read is in model_room (resource_control.py:290). 13ddfc5 moved the other memory-only readers to host(profile=False) and missed these two; brain_runtime.py:11-13 states the rule. On the ThinkPad it means the 5 s service tick and every model launch read the package inventory (a dpkg-query every 15 min, PACKAGES_FOR=900) to learn free memory, and any exception there silently stops work continuing. (2) STALE: since 0.2a3 (P06, version.py:46) background work yields for an 8 s foreground lease (resource_control.py:74-84, 316); the check calls pump within 8 s of window activity.
